entries.reason: JOV-13083 requires the existing webhook serverFetch pattern: one 4.5s dispatch POST to fixed JovieInc/ci per verified delivery, no transport retry, 24-hour durable replay lock and separate least-privilege REGISTRY_DISPATCH_TOKEN.

The quota sample already calls api.github.com. A required-green BLOCKED head dispatches this same workflow with the job GITHUB_TOKEN because the Jovie Bot installation has no actions: write and another github-script or gh step would grow the shrink-only ratchet.
Mints the Jovie Bot installation token the client layer itself authenticates with; the budget read moves to apiclient in the lanes migration.
Research router source: the literal is the url passed to @jovie/api-client ApiClient.request, so the call is budgeted.
